conclusion.root_cause: ConfigMap key rename in payments-config-v5 (KAFKA_BROKERS → KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP) caused payments-svc v5.1.0 to fail during startup when attempting to read the required Kafka broker configuration. The application code still referenced the old KAFKA_BROKERS environment variable which no longer existed in the ConfigMap, resulting in immediate startup failure with exit code 1 and subsequent CrashLoopBackOff across all pods.
